name: FAI_SUPPT_OBJECTS_B_
description: This table stores information required by an agent tool to make a REST call on supported business objects.

columns.name: SUPPT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Object code of the supported business object.

columns.name: INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: This column represents the system name of the Supported Object.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column represents the system description of the Supported Object.

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Product family of the supported business object.

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.description: Product of the supported business object.

columns.name: OBJECT_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates if the REST service for the supported business object is based on Fusion ADF, Fusion BOSS or is external.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: The category of the supported business object.

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_PATH
columns.description: The REST resource name or path for the supported business object.

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The field on the REST resource for the supported business object that uniquely identifies a record.

columns.name: REST_SUPPORTED_OPERATIONS
columns.description: Indicates which operations are supported by the REST resource of the supported business object.

columns.name: PARENT_SUPPT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The parent supported business object.

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a supported child business object is mandatory for use with a tool.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the record was seeded by Oracle.

columns.name: API_SPEC
columns.description: OpenAPI Specification for the supported business object. This specification should contain only those fields that need to be supported by an associated REST tool.

columns.name: OBJECT_PROPERTIES
columns.description: Additional properties of the supported business object.

columns.name: SAMPLE_QUERIES
columns.description: Sample queries for the supported business object to send to the LLM.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
